explication: Reloader is a Kubernetes controller that watches configuration resources and triggers workload rollouts when relevant Secrets or ConfigMaps change. Its main path is cluster events through controller queues to reload handlers and Kubernetes workload updates; annotation-based selection, optional CSI support, notifications, HA leadership, and Prometheus metrics are additional capabilities. The README documents supported workload types and controls; unsampled implementation details are represented only at their supported directory paths.
